content: उत्सर्गः .²1 Laying or leaving a side, abandoning, suspension; श्रीलक्षणोत्सर्गविनीतवेषाः <ls>Ku. 7. 45</ls>. .²2 Pouring out, dropping down, emission; तोयोत्सर्गद्रुततरगतिः <ls>Me. 19</ls>, <ls n="Me.">39</ls>; so शुक˚. .²3 A gift, donation, giving away; (धनस्य) उत्सर्गेण शुध्यन्ति <ls>Ms. 11. 193</ls>. .²4 Spending; अर्थ˚ <ls>Mu. 3</ls>. .²5 Loosening, letting loose; as in वृषोत्सर्गः .²6 An oblation, libation. .²7 Excretion, voiding by stool <ab>&c.</ab>; पुरीष˚, मलमूत्र˚. .²8 Completion (as of study or a vow); <ab>cf.</ab> उत्सृष्टा वै वेदाः (<ab>opp.</ab> उपाकृता वै वेदाः). .²9 A general rule or precept (<ab>opp.</ab> अपवाद a particular rule or exception); अपवादैरिवोत्सर्गाः कृतव्यावृत्तयः परैः <ls>Ku. 2. 27</ls>, उपवाद इवोत्सर्गं व्यावर्तयितुमीश्वरः <ls>R. 15. 7</ls>. .²10 Offering what is promised (to gods, Brāhmaṇas <ab>&c.</ab>) with due ceremonies. .²11 The anus; मित्रमुत्सर्गे <ls>Ms. 12. 121</ls>. .²12 A heap, mass; अन्नस्य सुबहून् राजन्नुत्सर्गान्पर्वतोपमान् <ls>Mb. 14. 85. 38</ls>. .²13 Dedication, securing the services (of priests). उत्सर्गे तु प्रधानत्वात् <ab>etc.</ab> <ls>MS. 3. 7. 19</ls>. (where शबर paraphrases उत्सर्ग by परिक्रय).
